description: This file defines a custom Android ViewGroup called PictureLayout that manages a single child view and draws a Picture object. It overrides layout, measurement, drawing, and child management methods to enforce constraints and handle custom rendering.

classes.name: PictureLayout
classes.description: A custom ViewGroup that hosts a single child and renders a scaled Picture with custom drawing behavior.

methods.name: addView
methods.description: Overrides various addView methods to enforce only one child can be added to this layout.

methods.name: generateDefaultLayoutParams
methods.description: Returns default layout parameters for child views.

methods.name: onMeasure
methods.description: Measures child views and determines the size of the layout, considering background drawable minimum size.

methods.name: drawPict
methods.description: Helper method to draw the Picture object onto the Canvas with transformations.

methods.name: dispatchDraw
methods.description: Draws the Picture object onto the Canvas, splitting the drawing into quadrants with scaling.

methods.name: invalidateChildInParent
methods.description: Handles invalidation of child views by updating the dirty rectangle.

methods.name: onLayout
methods.description: Positions the single child within the layout.
